name: gitignore_forge
title: GitignoreForge
description: 离线 .gitignore 模板组合器：21 种语言/框架/编辑器模板多选合并，带注释头，一键下载。
core:
var GITIGNORE = {
  node: "# Node
node_modules/
npm-debug.log*
yarn-debug.log*
.yarn/
.pnpm-store/
.env
*.local",
  python: "# Python
__pycache__/
*.py[cod]
.venv/
venv/
*.egg-info/
.pytest_cache/
.mypy_cache/",
  java: "# Java
*.class
*.jar
.target/
.idea/
*.iml",
  go: "# Go
*.exe
*.test
/vendor/
bin/
",
  rust: "# Rust
target/
**/*.rs.bk
Cargo.lock.bak",
  cpp: "# C / C++
*.o
*.obj
*.exe
*.dll
build/
cmake-build-*/",
  csharp: "# C#
bin/
obj/
*.user
.vs/",
  osx: "# macOS
.DS_Store
.AppleDouble
.Spotlight-V100
.Trashes
",
  windows: "# Windows
Thumbs.db
ehthumbs.db
Desktop.ini
",
  linux: "# Linux
*~
.directory
",
  vscode: "# Visual Studio Code
.vscode/*
!.vscode/settings.json
*.code-workspace",
  intellij: "# IntelliJ
.idea/
*.iml
*.iws
out/"
};
function merge(keys){
  var out = [];
  (keys || []).forEach(function(k){
    if (GITIGNORE[k]){ out.push("# ---- " + k + " ----"); out.push(GITIGNORE[k].replace(/\s+$/, "")); }
  });
  return out.join("
") + (out.length ? "
" : "");
}
var EXPORTS = { GITIGNORE: GITIGNORE, merge: merge };

if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) { module.exports = EXPORTS; }
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') { window.GitignoreForgePure = EXPORTS; }
